description: The real-time metric accumulator fails to evict stale samples on window slides, retaining old values in the sum and miscalculating sliding averages.
spec_notes: Invariant: Window duration must be maintained strictly: samples older than (current_timestamp - window_duration) must be evicted.

tests.test_accumulator.py:
from accumulator import StreamAccumulator

def test_single_sample_average():
    acc = StreamAccumulator(window_duration=10.0)
    acc.record(100.0, 50.0)
    assert acc.get_average() == 50.0

def test_sliding_window_eviction():
    acc = StreamAccumulator(window_duration=10.0)
    acc.record(100.0, 10.0)
    acc.record(105.0, 20.0)
    acc.record(112.0, 30.0) # 100.0 should be evicted (112 - 10 = 102 cutoff)
    assert acc.window.get_count() == 2
    assert acc.get_average() == 25.0 # (20 + 30) / 2 = 25.0

def test_empty_accumulator_average():
    acc = StreamAccumulator(window_duration=5.0)
    assert acc.get_average() == 0.0
